title: Show processes listening on a protocol
summary: Identify which programs are listening for network connections on a specific protocol (like TCP or UDP). This helps you find out what applications are using network ports.

steps.explain: Display the PID and program name for processes listening on a specific protocol. Replace <PROTOCOL> with the protocol you want to check, such as 'tcp' or 'udp'.

placeholders.name: PROTOCOL
placeholders.description: The network protocol to check, e.g., tcp or udp
